name: Inflection End-to-End Daily ETL + Gold/Platinum Separation
description: Structural completion of daily Inflection ETL beyond bronze tier (INFINGE). Authorizes (a) automated daily gold chain trigger via EventBridge cron + nightly fallback + S3-event sentinel pattern (mirrors BD bd-canonical-prices-daily / bd-gold-nightly-fallback); (b) gold-completion sentinel write in orion-gold-dispatch.sh (currently MISSING — structural prerequisite for any S3-event-driven publisher chain); (c) full implementation of inf-portal-publisher and inf-portal-advisor-publisher Lambdas (currently STUBs returning {status:stub}); (d) Time Machine version capture (port bd-capture-output-versions); (e) gold/platinum separation enforcement — every Inflection portal API GW route migrated to read from platinum/* only; gold/ becomes strict internal staging tier; (f) weekly parity check Sunday cron (BD parity); (g) optional standalone price refresh gated on Phase 0 Orion REST sufficiency check.
source_brief: DS~A 5-gap MCP analysis 2026-05-07 + Andrew direct directive 'all pipelines running daily, gold runner running daily, proper separation between gold and platinum, ONLY PLATINUM OUTPUTS ARE FED TO PORTAL'
phase: Phase 1 — TO authoring + decomposition pending COO. **PRD v0.1 SHIPPED 2026-05-07** (1.0.0_SA_CTO). 9 TOs sized: Phase 1 daily-gold-trigger + sentinel + publisher implementation (5 TOs: TO-1 cron+fallback Terraform AE 0.7, TO-2 sentinel write DS~A, TO-3 publisher Lambda DS~A, TO-4 advisor-publisher Lambda DS~A, TO-5 S3-event rule AE 0.7); Phase 2 Time Machine + portal route migration (3 TOs: TO-6 capture-output-versions AE 0.7, TO-7 portal-route audit RD/DT, TO-8 gold->platinum read-path migration DS+RD multi-tranche); Phase 3 operational hardening (TO-9 weekly parity AE 0.7, TO-10 standalone prices conditional DS). Total ~12-15 effort-days across pods. RAVC1 issued to COO for immediate decomposition + multi-agent execution. **Triggering incident:** Joe Brandenburg accounts retroactively re-attributed in Orion rep_id=3 (IWM) -> rep_id=6 within last few days; bronze pull script hardcodes @RepIDs='3,11,12' (excludes 6); silver/transactions + canonical_nna carry stale IWM-aggregated data; portal NMNC/NNA inconsistency ($19.7M NMNC vs -$1.36M NNA) is surface symptom; **structural root cause is daily Inflection ETL never re-runs gold end-to-end against current bronze, so retroactive vendor attribution changes cannot propagate**. 5-same-class incidents in 14 days (AUDIT-002 prices stale, AUDIT-008 assets_v2 stale, AUDIT-008 INF_B_00 positions_mv stale, AUDIT-003 attribution typo, INFNNA NMNC/NNA discovery) — INFINGE addressed bronze; INFETL addresses gold + publish + portal-route. **Gold/platinum separation contract:** gold/ strict internal staging, only publishers may read; platinum/ is the read-only contract surface for portal; portal API GW must NOT read from gold/. Cross-pipeline note: BD currently writes gold/artifacts/*.json (does not honor this contract); harmonization is OUT OF SCOPE for INFETL per CTO ruling — defer BD migration as separate future project.
blocking: PRD v0.1 SHIPPED — handoff to COO for TO decomposition. Operational gates: (1) TO-2 (DS~A sentinel write) + TO-3 (DS~A publisher impl) + TO-4 (DS~A advisor-publisher impl) all share DS~A bandwidth — COO assigns sequencing or splits to other DS~B/~C/~D. (2) DS~A is concurrently in flight on INFNNA.001 transactions backfill + INFLFE.006-data — bandwidth conflict explicit. (3) TO-1 cron flips ENABLED only AFTER INFNNA.001 backfill ack to avoid first cron run firing against partial backfill. (4) TO-7 portal-route audit can ship independent of Phase 1 (informs scope; can run pre-Phase-1).
depends_on_note: INFETL inherits 5-tier reference model from INFINGE Phase 0/1 (Tier 1 auth EC2, Tier 2 bronze Lambdas + EC2, Tier 3 silver Lambda); extends to Tier 4 gold cron + Tier 5 publisher chain + Tier 5c Time Machine + Tier 6 portal-route platinum-only read contract. INFINGE Phase 1b ships in parallel; once both PRDs' Phase 1 lands, daily bronze->silver->gold->platinum->portal is end-to-end automated.
